CustomObject.description: Test support object for the vendored apex-rollup test suite. Open Impact patch E, see packages/core/vendor/apex-rollup/VENDOR.md. Upstream's tests use a Sales Cloud standard object as their calculation item; Core may not depend on that object and must compile on a Platform-only org, so this object stands in for it field for field. It ships with no tab, no layout and no permission set entry, and no code outside the vendored tests refers to it. Activities are enabled because one vendored test rolls an activity date up to a polymorphic parent.
CustomObject.label: Rollup Calc Item
